page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a baseline clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is configured with a single thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading overhead. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high clock speed position this instance as a premium resource density option for workloads requiring predictable, high-frequency CPU execution. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the hardware profile entirely on raw CPU and memory capacity.

Given the high clock speed and dedicated core configuration, the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is suited for compute-intensive applications, high-performance web serving, batch processing, and distributed analytics. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio also supports general-purpose enterprise applications and database workloads that do not require local storage.
